snippet.title: Bonza Planet Trailer
snippet.description: From the makers of Bonza Word Puzzle – App Store best of 2014. Combine word search, jigsaw and trivia to solve puzzles as you explore the world of Bonza Planet. This edition of Bonza highlights themes like Animals, Travel, Planet Earth, Humanity and Science.
